headline: Dataset is structurally clean and will train, but dedupe 4 label files with repeated boxes and 4 pairs of identical train images first; val is clean so your validation number will be trustworthy.
training_impact: Training runs fine and the val metric is meaningful — no val contamination, no missing/corrupt files, no class-id or normalisation defects. Left as-is, the 4 duplicated boxes double-count in the loss and break the one-target-per-object assumption used by NMS-free matchers, and the 8 duplicate train images over-weight their scenes — a small but real bias. Separately, 'book' is under-represented in train (74) vs val (228), so expect the book val score to read optimistically relative to train coverage.

decisions.rationale: Verified against raw bytes: line 9 of train/000000016451 repeats line 8, line 16 of train/000000136715 repeats line 6 (2 more files). The same box listed twice double-counts in the loss and breaks the one-target-per-object assumption for NMS-free matchers. All 4 are in train, so val is unaffected. Fix: dedupe the 4 label files (drop the repeated line in each).

4 pairs of train images at perceptual distance 0/64 — identical hash, the concentrated one-directional pattern of a real duplication bug, not scattered ambiguity. 8 of 472 train images (~1.7%) over-weight their scenes and inflate the reported dataset size. All in train, no val impact. Fix: remove one image from each of the 4 pairs.
